newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Inv down after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Inv down after earnings report.

text.p: Shares of Henderson Investment Ltd fell on Thursday after the company reported lower-than-expected earnings growth, brokers said.
"It was a bit lower than market forecasts and investors are taking it as an excuse to sell down the shares," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Henderson Investment shares fell HK$0.20, or 2.45 percent, to HK$7.95 in mid-morning trade.
The company posted a 16 percent rise in fiscal 1996 net profit to HK$1.89 billion. The consensus estimate was for net profit of HK$2.06 billion, according to the Estimate Directory.
Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities, said the earnings were in line with his expectations and the lack of positive surprises had prompted investors to take profit.
He expected the shares to gain support in the longer run on hopes of an infrastructure asset injection into the company by its ultimate controlling shareholder Henderson Land.
Li said the company's shares were attractive in the longer run since they were trading at a discount to net asset value of HK$9.57 per share.
